description: This source file implements the 'Display' class and related functionalities for managing display surfaces, input callbacks, and communication with a remote compositor in a Linux environment, specifically for Raspberry Pi 4 64-bit. It handles creation and destruction of surfaces, input event forwarding, and interaction with GBM and DRM for buffer management.
